_about: Niccolò Machiavelli (1469-1527) in English: Christian E. Detmold's The Historical, Political, and Diplomatic Writings (Boston: James R. Osgood, 1882, 4 vols.), raw IA OCR (Toronto); and the History of Florence from Gutenberg (a 1901 Universal Classics Library printing, New York; translator not named in the book, introduction by Hugo Albert Rennert). The Prince is held on the Adler shelf (Marriott, PG 1232) and singles-ideas-3 (Ricci), and Thomson's Discourses on singles-ideas; none is taken again. No uids minted.
